overall_summary: Data volume is low with views under 50 across all videos. However, topics centered around 'self respect' and boundary-setting actions (deleting chats, unsaving numbers) consistently outperform passive longing or overthinking topics. The afternoon slot (13:30–14:00 UTC) shows higher baseline engagement.

winning_patterns.pattern: Action-oriented 'Self Respect' themes over passive sad longing
winning_patterns.evidence: Video AfaLxMy6FMY (34 views) and aNR94Xxn0yM (24 views, 1 like) performed better than purely passive overthinking/sadness videos.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on themes where the protagonist takes a quiet, dignified action for self-worth.

winning_patterns.evidence: Top performing videos (34 views, 24 views, 18 views) were all published between 13:40 and 13:52 UTC.
winning_patterns.action: Schedule high-intent releases during the 13:30 - 14:00 UTC window.

weak_patterns.pattern: Vague background moods (e.g., cold tea, late night overthinking without specific resolution)
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos uIbMpCjVutQ (5 views) and WhJ-VwRa3Rg (7 views) struggled to hold attention.
weak_patterns.action: Replace abstract mood settings with sharp, micro-actions (e.g., toggling notifications, clearing gallery space).

experiment: Testing whether framed dignity/boundary-setting micro-actions drive higher audience retention than passive grief.
